---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible SDK defect using synthetic data
---

## What happened?

Describe the expected behavior and the observed result.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest runnable Python or TypeScript example using synthetic fixtures. Include the SDK version or commit, Python or Node.js version, operating system, and the entry point used.

## Evidence

Include sanitized errors and resource/cleanup outcomes. Distinguish offline tests from a live API request. Remove credentials, tokens, customer identifiers, audio, and transcripts.

For security-sensitive reports, follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/coval-ai/coval-sdk/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead of posting the details here.
